summary: Two churches: St. Margaret (Woodbury Heights) holds Sat 4 PM, Sun 8:30/10, Mon-Sat 8:30 AM and Saturday confessions; St. John Vianney (Deptford) holds Sun 11:30. Both November 2026 bulletins (all-image PDFs, read as rendered pages) agree. Thanksgiving: 9 AM Mass replaces 8:30. Open: where the Friday Adoration chapel (Our Lady of Guadalupe) is, and a website-only Sunday confession. The 6:45 AM school-day convent Mass is excluded.

slots.rationale: R32: both bulletins print it the same way, but neither says where the chapel is, and the website does not mention it. The parish has two churches plus a convent (745 Third St.) and rectory chapel (334 Beech Ave.), so it could be off-site. Leaning leave out per POLICY (unclear location); a reviewer who knows the chapel is in St. Margaret Church should choose that.
